units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 5:2:6">Y. Bets. V, 63ᵃ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="U01674"><he>שָׁעַן</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>תַּשִּׁים</he>, <he>תַּשִּׁין</he>. Midr. Sam. ch. IX <he>האילת הזו איבריה ת׳ וכ׳</he> the hind has tender limbs, and when she wants water, she is afraid &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:7">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> (play on <he>ת̇ש̇ו̇ק̇תו</he>, <cite ref="Song of Songs 7:11">Cant. VII, 11</cite>) <he>ת̇ש̇ים אנו ואפי׳ שאנו ת׳ אנו מק̇ו̇ים וכ׳</he> we are weak (in good deeds), but although we are weak, we hope for &c.
